column1: User cannot login to VPN since this morning. Tried restarting laptop and reinstalling the client but issue persists. Getting error code 403.

Cannot connect to shared drive at //fileserver/projects. Permission denied error. Need access urgently for project work.

Git clone failing with SSL certificate error. Certificate verification failed when trying to pull code from repo.
Slack notifications not arriving. Messages appear in app but phone notifications stopped working yesterday. Checked settings.
Database query timing out. Simple SELECT statement that used to run in seconds now takes 5+ minutes. No schema changes.
